title: pelargonium × sulphureum
intro: Pelargonium × sulphureum, commonly known as Cape Geranium, is a hybrid plant species within the Pelargonium genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, coughs, and fever. The health benefits of Cape Geranium include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as soothing sore throats and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as the primary compounds contributing to the plant's medicinal effects.
